Type: deco
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Rustic Mirror Wall Shelf, 24"H, White
Materials: Wood
Made from fir wood with a distressed white finish, this circular mirrored wall shelf is a perfect accent for rustic décor. The mirror reflects the beautiful natural grain of the wood’s inside rim, and the shelf is just the right size for displaying small treasures. 24"H x 24"W x 4"D Fir wood with MDF and mirror This mirror shelf's distressed white finish works well with a variety of home-décor themes, including modern simple and vintage. No hanging materials needed
